carryon_weight.value: A 26 lb (12 kg) carry-on bag is included in all fares. The captured page gives no cabin-bag dimensions.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: A checked bag can be added when booking or up to 48 hours before departure; after that the price goes up, and it is non-refundable.

included_fares.value: A 50 lbs/23kg checked bag is included in the Bee Smart, Premium Smart and Premium Flex fares; on other fares it can be added for a fee.

size_weight.value: Each checked bag up to 23kg (50lbs), with no combining of weight across bags, and up to 158 cm in height + width + length.

max_weight.value: The maximum weight of any bag accepted is 32kg, subject to an excess baggage fee.
